name: The Legend of Zelda: Gifts of Kinomi
summary: Zelda, Link and the Oracles have gone on vacation to a far land named Kinomi! One thing that Link forgot was that it’s the Oracles’ birthday! Who knew they shared one? Help Link find presents for both Nayru and Din, and maybe save the day while you’re at it! Secrets lie within this strange land, and you’ll soon find out why this land was once home to our fair duo of oracles…
